items.summary: Add a backend data model for file metadata records including id, owner (Principal), filename, contentType, size (bytes), uploadedAt (timestamp), and optional notes/tags fields, stored per-user like other entities
Add backend methods to create, list, get, update, and delete file metadata records, with authorization checks ensuring users can only access their own files
Add backend storage for file binary content using stable data structures (e.g., stable HashMap mapping file ID to Blob), and provide upload/download methods that enforce per-user authorization
Add React Query hooks (useFileMetadataList, useCreateFileMutation, useUpdateFileMutation, useDeleteFileMutation) in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts following existing patterns for other entities

Create a new Files page (frontend/src/pages/FilesPage.tsx) displaying a table or card list of file metadata with columns for filename, type, size, upload date, and actions (view, download, edit metadata, delete)
Add a file upload dialog component (frontend/src/components/files/FileUploadDialog.tsx) with file input, drag-and-drop support, optional notes field, and progress indicator during upload
Implement file download functionality that fetches file content from the backend and triggers a browser download with the correct filename and content type
Add a file metadata edit dialog (frontend/src/components/files/FileMetadataEditDialog.tsx) allowing the user to update filename and notes without re-uploading the file content
Add a 'Files' navigation item in the AppShell sidebar linking to the new Files page, using a file/folder icon and Persian label
Update the Dashboard page to show a count of stored files using the file metadata list query, displayed in a card similar to existing inbox/tasks/notes cards
Include file metadata in the data export/import functionality (frontend/src/components/settings/ImportExportSection.tsx) so users can back up and restore their file records along with other data
Add Persian translations for all file-related UI text (labels, buttons, messages, placeholders) to frontend/src/lib/fa.ts following existing naming conventions
